headline: Premier releases standalone and consolidated quarterly results
hook: Premier reports September quarter financial results
summary: Premier held a board meeting on November 5, 2026, to approve its financial results. The company reported both standalone and consolidated unaudited figures for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. These filings provide the latest data on the company's operational performance and profitability for the period.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings determine the company's valuation and stock price direction.
